name: Rensai☆Kisou Camellia Note ~Yume ni Shinobazu, Kirisake Otome!~
original_name: 恋祭☆綺想カメリアノート ～夢に忍ばず、斬り咲け乙女！～
source:
Shouichi is a normal student at Raikou Gakuen, which holds an event called Meikousai where students fight for ‘camellia pages’ which hold mysterious power, with the winner getting their wish granted. Even though Shouichi lost his camellia page pretty early, he found himself still stuck on the battlefield.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/03/01/march-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
翔一是雷光学园的一名普通学生。学园举办名为「明光祭」的活动，学生们为拥有神秘力量的「山茶花书页」而战，胜者便能实现愿望。尽管翔一很早就失去了自己的山茶花书页，他依然被困在战场上。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/03/01/march-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
